ram.assessment: MINIMAL — enough for Ollama 3B, too tight for 7B or video generation

storage.assessment: ADEQUATE for models, tight for video assets

gpu.name: Intel UHD Graphics
gpu.assessment: NO CUDA. Cannot run GPU workloads (Wan2.1, ComfyUI, SDXL, Flux).

ollama_llm.detail: qwen2.5:3b running on CPU. 7B possible but tight on 8GB RAM. 14B impossible (needs 16GB+).

wan21_video.detail: Requires NVIDIA CUDA GPU 8GB+ VRAM. Intel iGPU cannot run PyTorch CUDA.

image_generation.detail: SDXL needs 6GB VRAM minimum. Flux needs 12GB+. ComfyUI needs CUDA GPU.

voice_models.detail: Whisper runs on CPU. XTTS-v2 runs on CPU but slow. GPU would accelerate.

aerospace_sim.detail: Physics simulation and CFD require CUDA GPU for practical performance.
